title: 2024年6月四级真题 第3套 阅读1
paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
passage:
P1 It may sound surprising, but you don't have to be interested in fashion, or even in history, to enjoy Dress Codes: How the Laws of Fashion Made History. I happen to be interested in both, and ended up enjoying the book for completely different reasons.

P2 Richard Thompson Ford is a law professor, and you probably won't forget that for even one page. His carefully reasoned arguments, packed with examples, sound almost like reading a court opinion, only maybe wordier. You will probably never think of fashion as a trifle again.

P3 Ford's thesis is that the best way to understand what particular fashions meant in any given era is to look at the restrictions placed on them. Through this lens, he shows us that the first laws passed in the 1200s to ensure that only the nobility were allowed to wear certain fabrics, colors and ornaments reflected the rise of the middle class, who were now able to imitate some of these fashions. The status of the upper classes was threatened; fashion was a tool to preserve it.

P4 Ford takes the reader through the evolution of fashion while examining the underlying motivations of status, sex, power, and personality, which, he assumes, influenced all innovations in fashion in the past and which continue to influence us today. His writing is more than a little dense— dense with research, clauses, and precise adjectives and nouns. But there's also humor and enough interesting episodes to make the writing appealing. No one is spared his sharp analysis: not the easy targets of 19th century women's crippling(伤害身体的) fashions nor the modern uniforms of Silicon Valley T-shirts

P5 But the greatest strength of this book (on fashion!) is its intellectual profoundness. Ford asks us to question unconscious beliefs, to realize that we almost never do so, to understand that the simplest choices are charged with meaning, and yet that meaning can and does change all the time. Consider the fact that a 1918 catalog insisted that boys and girls be dressed in the appropriate color. We believe our thinking today is evolved; Ford shows us it's not.

questions.q: What does the author think of the book Dress Codes: How the Laws of Fashion Made History?
options: It is read by people for entirely different reasons.
It is meant for those interested in fashion history.
It makes enjoyable as well as informative reading.
It converts fashion into something for deliberation.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author think of the book 问的是作者对整本书的看法，不针对任何细节 段，属于全文评价层面的主旨态度问题。

【拆句】主干 What does the author think of the book：think of 在此是「认为……怎么样」的固 定搭配，of 后接评价对象；书名作 of 的宾语。无陷阱。 46. What does the author think of the book Dress Codes: How the Laws of Fashion Made History? A) It is read by people for entirely different reasons. B) It is meant for those interested in fashion history. C) It makes enjoyable as well as informative reading. D) It converts fashion into something for deliberation.

【选项】A) 过度推断 It is read by people for entirely different reasons 把 I happen to be interested in both, and ended up enjoying the book for completely different reasons 中「我个 人因不同理由喜欢」错误推广到所有读者群体。 B) 与原文相反 It is meant for those interested in fashion history 与 you don't have to be interested in fashion, or even in history, to enjoy 直接矛盾——原文是「不必对这两 者感兴趣也能享受」，选项却限定「专为感兴趣者而写」。 C) ✓ 正确 enjoy Dress Codes: How the Laws of Fashion Made History ↔enjoyable intellectual profoundness ↔informative enough interesting episodes to make the writing appealing ↔enjoyable It makes enjoyable as well as informative reading 用 enjoyable as well as informative 两个形容词分别对应「P1/P4 阅读体验」和「P5 思想深度」两条主线，是 唯一同时覆盖两面的选项。 D) 过度推断 It converts fashion into something for deliberation 把 You will probably never think of fashion as a trifle again 过度解读为「把时尚转化为可供深思的事物」，把作 者对一句话的预测拔成全书定位。 根据Ford的观点,人们如何才能最好地理解某个时代的特定时尚? A) 通过审视施加在时尚上的限制。 B) 通过观察贵族的穿着。 C) 通过浏览时尚的面料、颜色和装饰。 D) 通过对上层阶级和中产阶级进行调查。

questions.q: How can people best understand a particular fashion in an era, according to Ford?
options: By examining the restraints imposed on it.
By looking at what the nobility were wearing.
By glancing at its fabrics, colors and ornaments.
By doing a survey of the upper and middle classes
questions.explain:
【判型】How can people best understand a particular fashion in an era, according to Ford? 用 how 问具体方法，且明确归属 according to Ford，是定位 Ford 观点句的细节题。

【拆句】主干 How can people understand…，best 修饰 understand 表程度；in an era 限定 fashion 所处时代；句末 according to Ford 标注观点归属。无陷阱。

【定位】Ford's thesis is that the best way to understand what particular fashions meant in any given era is to look at the restrictions placed on them. Ford 的核心论点是：要理解某一时代里特定时尚的含义，最好的方式就是看强加在这些时 尚之上的种种限制。 47. How can people best understand a particular fashion in an era, according to Ford? A) By examining the restraints imposed on it. B) By looking at what the nobility were wearing. C) By glancing at its fabrics, colors and ornaments. D) By doing a survey of the upper and middle classes

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 look at the restrictions placed on them ↔examining the restraints imposed on it 四个选项中只有 By examining the restraints imposed on it 完整还原「观察—限制」 这一对核心语义，与预判完全等值。 B) 拿例证替换方法 By looking at what the nobility were wearing 只截取 the nobility were allowed to wear certain fabrics, colors and ornaments 这处例证，没回到 Ford 真正提出的方法 ——「看限制」。 C) 偷换概念 By glancing at its fabrics, colors and ornaments 取自 certain fabrics, colors and ornaments，是 1200s 立法所限制的具体内容，被偷换成了「理解时尚的方法」。 D) 无中生有 By doing a survey of the upper and middle classes 中 doing a survey 文中并无任 何对应，Ford 谈的是「看限制」而非做问卷或调查。 13世纪通过的第一批有关时尚的法律的目的是什么? A) 促进中产阶级的崛起。 B) 放宽对着装规范的限制。 C) 帮助创立一些新颖的时尚。 D) 维护贵族的地位。

questions.q: What was the aim of the first laws passed regarding fashion in the 1200s?
options: To facilitate the rise of the middle class.
To loosen restrictions on dress codes.
To help initiate some novel fashions
To preserve the status of the nobles.
questions.explain:
【判型】What was the aim of the first laws 问的是某一具体历史事件的目的，需要回原文找对应 「目的/原因」表述。

【拆句】主干 What was the aim of the first laws…？aim of 后接修饰首批法律的两个定语 passed regarding fashion 和 in the 1200s。无陷阱。

【定位】the first laws passed in the 1200s to ensure that only the nobility were allowed to wear certain fabrics, colors and ornaments reflected the rise of the middle class, who were now able to imitate some of these fashions. The status of the upper classes was threatened; fashion was a tool to preserve it. 1200 年代通过的最早一批法律，规定只有贵族才能穿戴某些面料、颜色与饰品；这些法律 折射出中产阶级的崛起，因为他们已能模仿其中一些时尚。上层阶级的地位受到威胁，时尚 成为维持这一地位的工具。 48. What was the aim of the first laws passed regarding fashion in the 1200s? A) To facilitate the rise of the middle class. B) To loosen restrictions on dress codes. C) To help initiate some novel fashions D) To preserve the status of the nobles.

【选项】A) 与原文相反 To facilitate the rise of the middle class 把「中产阶级崛起」当成目的，但原文是中 产阶级崛起在前、立法在后，立法是为了反制这种崛起、保护贵族。 B) 与原文相反 To loosen restrictions on dress codes 与原文「立法是限制」的方向完全相反，原文 是 only the nobility were allowed to wear，明显是加紧而非放松。 C) 无中生有 To help initiate some novel fashions 称立法是为了开启新潮流，文中只字未提；原文 谈的是用法律压制模仿，而非鼓励创新。 D) ✓ 正确 The status of the upper classes was threatened; fashion was a tool to preserve it ↔ To preserve the status of the nobles only the nobility were allowed to wear certain fabrics, colors and ornaments ↔ To preserve the status of the nobles 预判「维护贵族地位」直接对应 To preserve the status of the nobles，preserve、 status、nobles 三个关键词全部命中，是直白的同义重述。 作者如何看待Ford的写作? A) 在描述不同时代的时尚时运用了比较和对照。 B) 阅读起来费力但不乏幽默感和吸引力。 C) 充满有趣的小插曲,使读者免于难以忍受的枯燥。 D) 在论证方面具有学术特征。

questions.q: What does the author think of Ford's writing?
options: It uses comparison and contrast in describing fashions of different eras.
It makes heavy reading but is not lacking in humor or appeal.
It is filled with interesting episodes to spare readers intolerable boredom.
It is characteristic of academics in presenting arguments.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author think of Ford's writing? 评价对象是局部的 writing，不是全书， 属于一段内的评价细节题。

【拆句】主干 What does the author think of Ford's writing？think of 仍是固定搭配「对…怎么 看」。无陷阱。

【定位】His writing is more than a little dense—dense with research, clauses, and precise adjectives and nouns. But there's also humor and enough interesting episodes to make the writing appealing. 他的写作可以说相当密实——密集的研究、从句以及精准的形容词与名词。但其中也不乏幽 默与足够多的有趣片段，使得整本书读来仍具吸引力。 49. What does the author think of Ford's writing? A) It uses comparison and contrast in describing fashions of different eras. B) It makes heavy reading but is not lacking in humor or appeal. C) It is filled with interesting episodes to spare readers intolerable boredom. D) It is characteristic of academics in presenting arguments.

【选项】A) 无中生有 It uses comparison and contrast in describing fashions of different eras 谈 Ford 用了 comparison and contrast，P4 通篇没有这层评价。 B) ✓ 正确 His writing is more than a little dense ↔makes heavy reading there's also humor and enough interesting episodes to make the writing appealing ↔ not lacking in humor or appeal It makes heavy reading but is not lacking in humor or appeal 用 but 连接，分别 对接原文 dense 与 But there's also humor and …appealing 两个分句，与预判完全 一致。 C) 过度推断 It is filled with interesting episodes to spare readers intolerable boredom 把原文 「也有」夸成「充满」，把「使写作吸引人」放大为「拯救读者免于难以忍受的无 聊」，与 dense 评价并列存在的事实矛盾。 D) 以偏概全 It is characteristic of academics in presenting arguments 与 sound almost like reading a court opinion, only maybe wordier 有关，但题目问的是 P4 段的写作评 价；且选项遗漏了「幽默与吸引力」这一面。 作者认为Ford这本书的最大优势是什么? A) 丰富的信息。 B) 有意义的选择。 C) 深化的思考。 D) 思想深度。

questions.q: What does the author say is the greatest strength of Ford's book?
options: Plentiful information.
Meaningful choices.
Evolved thinking.
Intellectual depth
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author say is the greatest strength of Ford's book? 问「最大优点是什 么」，文中必有显式表述，属细节定位题。

【拆句】主干 What does the author say is the greatest strength…？嵌套宾语从句 the author say + 主语 [the greatest strength of Ford's book] + 系动词 is，问的是表语的内容。无 陷阱。

【定位】But the greatest strength of this book (on fashion!) is its intellectual profoundness. 但这本（讲时尚的！）书最大的优点，是它在思想上的深刻。 50. What does the author say is the greatest strength of Ford's book? A) Plentiful information. B) Meaningful choices. C) Evolved thinking. D) Intellectual depth

【选项】A) 张冠李戴 Plentiful information 把 dense with research 误当作本段「最大优点」，跨段错位， 且 Ford 的写作密度在原文是写作风格而非最大优点。 B) 以偏概全 Meaningful choices 取自 the simplest choices are charged with meaning，那是支 撑思想深度的细节，不是最大优点本身。 C) 与原文相反 Evolved thinking 直接对应 We believe our thinking today is evolved; Ford shows us it's not，作者明确指出今天的思维其实并未进化——把它当作 Ford 书的最大优点， 与原文结论完全相反。 D) ✓ 正确 intellectual profoundness ↔Intellectual depth Intellectual depth 与预判「思想上的深刻」语义一一对应，无任何缩放或偷换。
